title: Enjoyable Driving Experience
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the F70 as enjoyable and pleasant to drive, while a few negative examples in the sample actually focus on ConnectedDrive rather than driving feel.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as fun, lovely, and very good to drive, often highlighting lasting enjoyment behind the wheel.

negative.summary: Negative reviews are present, but the supplied examples point to dissatisfaction with ConnectedDrive rather than the way the car drives.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the cars drive very well and are great fun, but the sample does not include the offsetting negative point.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention driving or ownership context without a clear evaluative stance, and some examples are too ambiguous to classify confidently from the fragment alone.

limitations: The negative examples in the supplied sample are about ConnectedDrive, so they may not reflect dissatisfaction with driving enjoyment itself.
The mixed sample is insufficient because the provided fragment only shows the positive side of the review.
Many undetermined fragments mention driving in a descriptive or contextual way without enough sentiment to interpret them clearly.
The selected fragments are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
